case.title: Operation Shadow Network
case.summary: Evidence currently supports a coordinated inside operation involving Arthur Vance, financial routing through Meridian Holdings, and a four-person associate network. Direct vault access remains unproven.
case.insight: Arthur Vance is the central actor. CDR, witness, location, and financial records converge around the heist window, while CCTV enhancement and ownership verification remain open gaps.

agents.name: Lead Investigation
agents.summary: The strongest working theory is a coordinated inside operation led by Arthur Vance.

agents.name: Criminal Intel & Link Analysis
agents.summary: Arthur Vance is the network centre, with Reed, Carter, and Drew operating as connected intermediaries.

agents.name: Digital Forensics
agents.summary: Device and browser artifacts provide a reproducible technical trail connected to the investigation.

agents.name: Financial Investigation
agents.summary: A $2.3M credit was followed by rapid transfers to Reed, Drew, Carter, and the warehouse lease.

agents.name: Cyber & Telecom
agents.summary: Telecom records correlate the SIM change, tower overlap, and final call with the associate network.

agents.name: Timeline Reconstruction
agents.summary: Eight events align from the Cafe Lumiere meeting through the warehouse activity on 03/12.

agents.name: Prosecution / Evidence Sufficiency
agents.summary: Scene presence is supported, but direct proof of vault access and complete financial routing is still missing.
findings: Scene presence supported by three sources

agents.name: Defense / Adversarial Challenge
agents.summary: Credential compromise and independent-actor explanations remain plausible alternatives to test.

agents.name: Evidence Integrity Validator
agents.summary: Six claims are corroborated; one inferred location claim is rejected pending source review.

agents.name: Judicial Reasoning
agents.summary: H1 is currently strongest, but the evidence is not conclusive while CCTV and ownership gaps remain.
